description: Hi! I’m so excited for this space mission game. I love aliens, outer space, and imagining new worlds! I am really good at coming up with wild ideas / drawing cool spacesuits / staying super focused and helping everyone on my team. You should join my team because we are going to have the most creative ideas and the best time working together! I am looking for friends who are great at fixing problems / doing math / making cool pictures. Let’s blast off together
